title: Branch Wars
one_paragraph_synopsis: In "Branch Wars," the Scranton branch faces internal and external challenges as Karen, the regional manager of the Utica branch, attempts to recruit Stanley away. Michael tries to retain Stanley by appealing to his value and attempts to poach Ben, Utica's top salesman. Meanwhile, Michael and Dwight execute a prank on the Utica branch, involving Jim reluctantly, which leads to a series of mishaps including Dwight throwing Jim's phone out the window and the duo getting trapped under an industrial copier. Concurrently, Pam, Oscar, and Toby form the exclusive Finer Things Club, which Andy unsuccessfully tries to join, causing tension. The episode explores workplace rivalry, loyalty, and social dynamics within the office.
